composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-115, "AFT SERVICE PUMPS") is a DC MAIN PANEL / MAIN PANEL load-and-control sheet for a group of aft grey-water/sump pumps plus one A/C sump pump, all fed from the DC main panel breakers Q1-Q6 and controlled/monitored via a PC CARD (Onyx-style I/O) with terminal strips T/S B, T/S C, T/S E, T/S F and XA60/XA61/XA70/XA30 tap families. Each breaker row names its own pump load (AFT GREY WATER, PORT/STBD AFT GREY GUEST SUMP, FWD/AFT CREW HEAD SUMP, AFT A/C SUMP), matching the engineer-confirmed vocabulary mapping AFT GREY WATER PUMP -> 530-grey-water-pumps and the various guest/crew/A/C sump pumps -> 530-sump-pumps. A block of PC-CARD alarm inputs (MAST BILGE, ENGINE ROOM BILGE, OWNERS GREY SUMP, FWD GUEST GREY SUMP, AFT A/C SUMP) are alarm-status inputs from OTHER sumps/bilges not physically wired to loads on this sheet — they are monitoring taps only. FWD GREY WATER (S18 selector + sender) is a second, separate pump loop sharing the sheet but fed from its own breaker (unlabelled on this crop) and belonging to 530-grey-water-pumps as well. A GMDSS/backup-EM-power alarm input and an emergency-lights-switch link (T/S E terminal 57, MU4-12 to T/S F on DWG-120) are cross-references to other systems (632/631 battery backup, 693 emergency lighting) monitored/patched through this sheet's terminal strips but not powered from here.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Row explicitly labelled 'AFT GREY WATER P.' fed by Q1 10A, driving a PUMP symbol labelled 'AFT GREY WATER' on the right, plus an S17 ON/OFF/AUTO selector and a level sender — matches engineer mapping AFT GREY WATER PUMP -> 530-grey-water-pumps.

functions.label: AFT grey water pump supply, mode select and run/alarm indication
functions.what_it_does: Drives the AFT grey water discharge pump from the DC main panel, selectable ON/OFF/AUTO from the main panel switch S17, with running and alarm status returned to the PC card, and tank level reported via a sender to the panel gauge/monitor.
functions.sheet_region: top-left (DC MAIN PANEL / MAIN PANEL, rows terminal 76-81) and top-right (AFT GREY WATER pump + sender)
key_components: AFT GREY WATER SENDER (level sender, UNBOUND on netlist - connection to gauge not measured)

flow_scenarios.path: DC Main Panel Q1 (10A) -> AFT GREY WATER P. feed -> Re12 relay contact (NO, closes on command) -> T/S C terminal 76/77 -> pump motor 'AFT GREY WATER' (+); run indication returns via T/S C terminal 78/79 to PC CARD RUN IND.; alarm status via terminal 80/81 to PC CARD ALARM and out to XA61-08 (status tap, net21/net924 — XA61 here also reaches Re12 coil, i.e. is a command path into the loop per measured netlist).
S17 selector (mounted on MAIN PANEL) commands pump run mode; contact state is NO per measurement — selecting ON/AUTO closes the loop enabling Re12; loop returns for run/alarm as above.
AFT GREY WATER SENDER wired to SWB02/AFT terminals XA70-07(+)/XA70-08(-) feeding a gauge/indicator on the right of the sheet — sender-to-gauge net not further measured on this sheet.

functions.dry_data: Breaker Q1, 10A, DC Main Panel; relay Re12; selector S17 ON/OFF/AUTO; level sender via XA70-07/-08.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: PORT AFT GUEST GREY SUMP PUMP
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Row labelled 'PORT AFT GREY GUEST SUMP' fed by Q2 20A, terminals 82/83, driving pump symbol 'PORT AFT GUEST GREY SUMP' with its own fused terminal (1A) and switch — matches PORT AFT GREY GUEST SUMP -> 530-sump-pumps.

functions.label: Port aft guest grey sump pump supply and run indication
functions.what_it_does: Drains the port aft guest cabin grey-water sump, powered from the DC main panel and switched locally, with a run-indication tap back to the PC card.
functions.sheet_region: left-mid (Q2 20A row, terminals 82/83) and right (PORT AFT GUEST GREY SUMP pump + fused terminal 1A + switch)
key_components: Fused terminal 1A (built-in replaceable fuse) in series with the local switch ahead of the pump

flow_scenarios.path: DC Main Panel Q2 (20A) -> terminal strip 82/83 (shared net net45/net52/net686 — common rail with contact 82, coil 83, FUSE, and TERMINAL STRIP) -> via fused terminal '1A' -> local switch (drawn closed, NO type) -> PORT AFT GUEST GREY SUMP pump motor; run indication returns from terminal 82/83 to PC CARD RUN IND.

Contact 82 is NO and shares coil 83's net with the fused terminal and switch — energising coil 83 closes contact 82, connecting supply to the pump; coil 83's own feed/return sides are not distinctly traced beyond this shared net (COMMON RAIL net45/net686).

functions.dry_data: Breaker Q2, 20A; fused terminal rated 1A at the pump end; contact/coil pair 82/83.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Row labelled 'STBD AFT GREY GUEST SUMP' fed by Q3 20A, terminals 84/85, driving pump symbol 'STBD AFT GUEST GREY SUMP' with fused terminal 1A and switch, mirroring the port row — matches STBD AFT GREY GUEST SUMP -> 530-sump-pumps.

functions.label: Stbd aft guest grey sump pump supply and run indication
functions.what_it_does: Drains the starboard aft guest cabin grey-water sump, powered from the DC main panel and switched locally, with run indication back to the PC card.
functions.sheet_region: left-mid (Q3 20A row, terminals 84/85) and right (STBD AFT GUEST GREY SUMP pump + fused terminal 1A + switch)
key_components: Fused terminal 1A ahead of the pump

flow_scenarios.path: DC Main Panel Q3 (20A, breaker rating printed on sheet, Q3 itself UNBOUND on netlist — downstream terminal net 54/362/687 measured) -> terminal 84/85 -> via fused terminal '1A' -> local switch -> STBD AFT GUEST GREY SUMP pump motor; run indication returns to PC CARD RUN IND.
Contact 84 is NO, coil 85 — energising coil 85 closes contact 84 to pass supply to the pump; feed/return of coil 85 itself not further traced beyond its shared nets.

functions.dry_data: Breaker Q3, 20A; fused terminal rated 1A; contact/coil pair 84/85.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Row labelled 'FWD CREW HEAD SUMP PUMP' fed by Q4 10A via relay Re13, terminals 86-88, driving pump 'FWD CREW HEAD GREY SUMP' with a BY-PASS/REED SUMP SW. arrangement — matches FWD CREW SUMP PUMP -> 530-sump-pumps.

functions.label: Fwd crew head grey sump pump supply with reed-switch level control and manual bypass
functions.what_it_does: Empties the forward crew head grey-water sump; the pump is normally controlled automatically by a reed float switch, with a manual BY-PASS pushbutton available to force running, and run indication reported to the PC card.
functions.sheet_region: left-lower (Q4 10A / Re13 row, terminals 86-88) and right (FWD CREW HEAD GREY SUMP pump, BY-PASS + REED SUMP SW.)
key_components: Re13 relay (contact NO, on nets net267/net585-587/net637/net638)

flow_scenarios.state: Automatic (reed switch closes on rising sump level)
flow_scenarios.path: DC Main Panel Q4 (10A) -> Re13 relay contact -> terminal 86/87/88 -> pump feed line to FWD CREW HEAD GREY SUMP pump; the REED SUMP SW. (NO, closes on float rise) completes the pump's negative/return leg on its own net (net50/net59), starting the pump; run indication returns via terminal 87 (net492) to PC CARD RUN IND.

BY-PASS pushbutton (NO) wired in parallel with the REED SUMP SW. on the same net (net50/net59) — pressing BY-PASS closes the same return path independent of float level, forcing the pump to run for manual clearing.

Contacts 86 and 88 are both NO on coil 87 — energising Re13/coil 87 closes both, routing supply through to the pump circuit; the coil's own supply-side feed is via Q4/Re13 per the row, negative return not separately traced beyond the shared nets.

functions.dry_data: Breaker Q4, 10A; relay Re13; float-actuated REED SUMP SW. with manual BY-PASS override.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Row labelled 'AFT CREW HEAD SUMP PUMP' fed by Q5 10A via relay Re14, terminals 89-91, driving pump 'AFT CREW HEAD GREY SUMP' with its own BY-PASS/REED SUMP SW., mirroring the FWD crew head row — matches AFT CREW SUMP PUMP -> 530-sump-pumps.

functions.label: Aft crew head grey sump pump supply with reed-switch level control and manual bypass
functions.what_it_does: Empties the aft crew head grey-water sump; normally started by a reed float switch, with a manual BY-PASS override, run indication and alarm status reported to a shared PC-card alarm bank alongside other bilge/sump alarms.
functions.sheet_region: left-lower (Q5 10A / Re14 row, terminals 89-91) and right (AFT CREW HEAD GREY SUMP pump, BY-PASS + REED SUMP SW.)

flow_scenarios.state: Automatic (reed switch closes on rising sump level)
flow_scenarios.path: DC Main Panel Q5 (10A) -> Re14 relay contact -> terminal 89/90/91 -> pump feed to AFT CREW HEAD GREY SUMP pump; REED SUMP SW. (NO) on its own net closes the pump's return leg to start it on float rise; run indication returns via terminal 90/91 (RUN IND.) to PC CARD.
BY-PASS pushbutton (NO) in parallel with REED SUMP SW. on the same net — pressing it forces the pump on regardless of float state.

Both contacts 89 and 91 are NO on coil 90 (common rail net216, shared with other alarm terminals 92-96) — energising coil 90 closes them to pass supply through to the pump; coil 90's own feed/return not separately traced beyond the shared nets.

Terminals 92-96 on the same common rail as 89-91/coil90 also carry MAST BILGE, ENGINE ROOM BILGE, OWNERS GREY SUMP, FWD GUEST GREY SUMP and AFT A/C SUMP alarm inputs from OTHER pump circuits (not powered from this row) — these are status/alarm taps into the PC CARD ALARM block, not part of the aft crew head pump's own drive circuit.

functions.dry_data: Breaker Q5, 10A; relay Re14; float-actuated REED SUMP SW. with manual BY-PASS override.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Row labelled 'AFT A/C SUMP PUMP' fed by Q6 20A, driving pump 'AFT A/C SUMP PUMP' with a fused terminal 1A and switch, plus an S18 ON/OFF/AUTO selector labelled 'FWD GREY WATER' alongside — the pump load itself is the AFT A/C sump; falls under sump-pumps grouping (no separate register entry for A/C sump).

functions.label: Aft air-conditioning condensate sump pump supply and run/alarm indication
functions.what_it_does: Drains condensate from the aft A/C sump, powered from the DC main panel via a fused terminal and local switch, with run and alarm status returned to the PC card alongside the other sump alarms.
functions.sheet_region: left-lower (Q6 20A row) and right (AFT A/C SUMP PUMP pump + fused terminal 1A + switch)

flow_scenarios.path: DC Main Panel Q6 (20A) -> terminal strip (row below terminals 92-96, i.e. terminals 97-101 group per layout) -> via fused terminal '1A' -> local switch -> AFT A/C SUMP PUMP motor; run indication (RUN IND.) and alarm status return to PC CARD terminals 97-101.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The S18 ON/OFF/AUTO selector is explicitly labelled 'FWD GREY WATER' on the sheet, with its own sender loop via SWB01/FWD terminals XA30-01(+)/XA30-02(-) to a 'FWD GREY WATER SENDER' — a second, separate grey-water pump control loop co-located on this sheet with the aft one; matches FWD GREY WATER PUMP -> 530-grey-water-pumps.

functions.label: Fwd grey water pump mode selection and tank level sensing (control/monitoring loop only)
functions.what_it_does: Provides ON/OFF/AUTO mode selection for the forward grey water pump (S18) and a level sender loop to a forward-mounted gauge; this sheet does not show the FWD grey water pump's own breaker/motor circuit — those are on a different sheet/breaker not captured in this crop.
functions.sheet_region: mid-right (S18 selector labelled FWD GREY WATER) and lower-right (SWB01/FWD, FWD GREY WATER SENDER)
key_components: FWD GREY WATER SENDER (level sender, UNBOUND — connection to gauge not measured)

flow_scenarios.path: S18 selector (ON/OFF/AUTO) ties into PC CARD terminals 97-101 alongside the AFT A/C sump alarm/run block — shared net (net43/net55/net208/net209) indicates S18's command lines share terminals with that block; exact device driven by S18 is not distinctly separated from the AFT A/C sump terminals on the measured netlist.

FWD GREY WATER SENDER wired to SWB01/FWD terminals XA30-01(+)/XA30-02(-) feeding a gauge — sender-to-gauge net not further measured; XA61-18 tap also references 'FWD BLACK WATER TANK FULL SIGNAL, see DWG115a' — a cross-reference, not part of this loop.

functions.dry_data: Selector S18 ON/OFF/AUTO; sender via XA30-01/-02.

infrastructure.system_name: DC Main Panel / Main Panel distribution and terminal strips (T/S B, T/S C, T/S E, T/S F) and PC CARD I/O
facts: Sheet header shows 'DC MAIN PANEL' and 'MAIN PANEL' as the two source panels for all breakers Q1-Q6 on this sheet.
PC CARD (dotted box) is the Onyx-style I/O module carrying RUN IND. and ALARM taps for each pump plus the S17/S18 selectors.
T/S E terminal 8 carries EMERGENCY BAT +24V feed onto this sheet (cross-reference to 632-battery-emergency) into terminal strip, not into any pump load directly.
T/S E terminal 57 carries an 'EMERGENCY LTS SW Link' — cross-reference to 693-emergency-lighting, patched via terminals 103-105.
T/S F (see DWG-120) terminals 19-24 continue via MU4-12 multi-core cable to an EMERGENCY LTS SW elsewhere; terminals 23/24 marked 'not used' (spare ways).

infrastructure.system_name: Shared alarm/status bank (mast bilge, engine room bilge, owners grey sump, fwd guest grey sump, aft A/C sump) — cross-reference inputs only
facts: PC CARD terminals 92-96 list five alarm labels (MAST BILGE, ENGINE ROOM BILGE, OWNERS GREY SUMP, FWD GUEST GREY SUMP, AFT A/C SUMP) sharing common-rail net216/net825/net838/net839/net868/net872/net1258/net2092/net2095/net2209 with the aft crew head relay contacts 89/90/91 — these are STATUS inputs from other pump circuits into the monitoring/alarm block, not loads driven from this sheet.
Terminal block 'BACKUP EM POWER (GMDSS BACKUP)' also lands on this same alarm bank — a status tap referencing GMDSS backup power (631/632 battery banks), not a control input.
